executive_summary: Maven build failed with 2 test errors in GlobalExceptionHandlerTest. Both failures are caused by NullPointerException when attempting to invoke getParameterIndex() on a null MethodParameter object. The test methods are trying to handle MethodArgumentNotValidException but the exception object is not properly initialized with a valid MethodParameter, causing the handler to fail when trying to access parameter information.

errors.message: NullPointerException: Cannot invoke getParameterIndex() because parameter is null
errors.root_cause: The test creates a MethodArgumentNotValidException without properly initializing the MethodParameter field. When GlobalExceptionHandler.handleMethodArgumentNotValid() calls exception.getMessage(), it internally tries to access this.parameter.getParameterIndex(), but this.parameter is null.
errors.fix_recommendation: In GlobalExceptionHandlerTest.handleMethodArgumentNotValid_ReturnsBadRequest(), create a valid MethodParameter object before constructing MethodArgumentNotValidException. Use: MethodParameter parameter = new MethodParameter(TaskController.class.getMethod(
, TaskCreateRequest.class), 0); Then pass this parameter when creating the exception.

errors.message: NullPointerException: Cannot invoke getParameterIndex() because parameter is null
errors.root_cause: Same as the first error - the test creates a MethodArgumentNotValidException without properly initializing the MethodParameter field, causing a NullPointerException when the handler tries to access parameter information.
errors.fix_recommendation: In GlobalExceptionHandlerTest.handleMethodArgumentNotValid_WithSingleError_ReturnsBadRequest(), create a valid MethodParameter object before constructing MethodArgumentNotValidException. Use: MethodParameter parameter = new MethodParameter(TaskController.class.getMethod(
, TaskCreateRequest.class), 0); Then pass this parameter when creating the exception.
